ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity pixels (approx. 85-90% dark) with isolated high-intensity (white) focal points across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dense distribution of discrete, high-contrast white circular and irregular blobs (mottling) scattered across the primary dark-pigmented field of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 70-75 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous serrated boundary with pixel-amplitude variations (peaks and valleys) of 3-10 pixels along the entire trailing edge, most pronounced on the distal sections.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory along the trailing edge of both lobes, flaring into slightly up-curved distal terminals.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular white pixel groups (diameter 5-15 pixels) concentrated on the medial left lobe and lower central fluke area.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several short, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) visible on the surface of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant accumulation of white scarring and textural irregularities at the distal tips; extensive ventral scarring consistent with historical barnacle colonization.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique 'salt-and-pepper' or 'starry' pigmentation pattern characterized by extreme frequency of small white scars against a dark background.
